text_en: The word of the Lord came to me:
text_cn: 上主的话传给我说：

text_en: Mortal, there were two women, the daughters of one mother;
text_cn: “人子，有两个女人，同是一母的女儿，

text_en: they played the whore in Egypt; they played the whore in their youth; their breasts were caressed there, and their virgin bosoms were fondled.
text_cn: 她们在埃及行过淫，年轻时当过娼，在那里有人抚弄过她们的乳房，在那里有人糟蹋了她们的童身。

text_en: Oholah was the name of the elder and Oholibah the name of her sister. They became mine, and they bore sons and daughters. As for their names, Oholah is Samaria, and Oholibah is Jerusalem.
text_cn: 她们的名字，大的叫敖曷拉，她妹妹叫敖曷里巴。她们本来属于我，也给我生了子女。至于她们的名字：敖曷拉是指撒玛黎雅，敖曷里巴是指耶路撒冷。

text_en: Oholah played the whore while she was mine; she lusted after her lovers the Assyrians, warriors
text_cn: 敖曷拉属我时，已行邪淫，恋爱了她的情人，邻邦亚述人，

text_en: clothed in blue, governors and commanders, all of them handsome young men, mounted horsemen.
text_cn: 即那穿紫红衣服的将领和公卿，全是英俊的青年，善于骑马的骑士。

text_en: She bestowed her favors upon them, the choicest men of Assyria all of them; and she defiled herself with all the idols of everyone for whom she lusted.
text_cn: 于是她与所有的亚述青年行淫，并为她所恋爱的情人及其偶像所玷污。

text_en: She did not give up her whorings that she had practiced since Egypt; for in her youth men had lain with her and fondled her virgin bosom and poured out their lust upon her.
text_cn: 但她仍没有放弃埃及的淫荡，因为他们在她青年时曾同她共寝过，糟蹋过她的童身，在她身上发泄过淫欲。

text_en: Therefore I delivered her into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the Assyrians, for whom she lusted.
text_cn: 为此我把她交在她情人手中，即她所热恋的亚述人手中。

text_en: These uncovered her nakedness; they seized her sons and her daughters; and they killed her with the sword. Judgment was executed upon her, and she became a byword among women.
text_cn: 他们必要揭露她的私处，掳去她的子女，用刀把她杀死：如此，因所加于她身上的惩罚，她成了妇女的警戒。

text_en: Her sister Oholibah saw this, yet she was more corrupt than she in her lusting and in her whorings, which were worse than those of her sister.
text_cn: 她妹妹敖曷里巴虽看见了这一切，但她的情欲更甚于她姐姐，她的淫乱也远超过她姐姐的淫乱。

text_en: She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and commanders, warriors clothed in full armor, mounted horsemen, all of them handsome young men.
text_cn: 她也恋爱那些身为将领公卿的邻邦亚述子民，他们都是衣着华美，善于骑马的骑士，而且都是英俊的青年。

text_en: And I saw that she was defiled; they both took the same way.
text_cn: 我也见了她受玷污，她们两的行径完全一样。

text_en: But she carried her whorings further; she saw male figures carved on the wall, images of the Chaldeans portrayed in vermilion,
text_cn: 她的淫行有增无减。当她看见绘画在墙上的人 —— 用丹青绘画的加色丁人像，

text_en: with belts around their waists, with flowing turbans on their heads, all of them looking like officers—a picture of Babylonians whose native land was Chaldea.
text_cn: 腰间束着佩带，头上缠着突出的头巾，都有军官的模样，相似巴比伦人，加色丁即是他们的出生地 ——

text_en: When she saw them she lusted after them, and sent messengers to them in Chaldea.
text_cn: 她的眼一看见，就爱上了他们，遣派使者往加色丁，到他们那里去。

text_en: And the Babylonians came to her into the bed of love, and they defiled her with their lust; and after she defiled herself with them, she turned from them in disgust.
text_cn: 巴比伦人一来到她那里，登上爱情的床，行了淫，玷污了她；她受玷污之后，遂即厌弃了他们。

text_en: When she carried on her whorings so openly and flaunted her nakedness, I turned in disgust from her, as I had turned from her sister.
text_cn: 她既暴露了自己的淫行，揭开了自己的私处，因此我也厌弃她，如同厌弃她姐姐一样。

text_en: Yet she increased her whorings, remembering the days of her youth, when she played the whore in the land of Egypt
text_cn: 她又想念年轻时在埃及行淫的日子，遂增强了她的淫欲。

text_en: and lusted after her paramours there, whose members were like those of donkeys, and whose emission was like that of stallions.
text_cn: 她仍恋爱体壮似驴，精足似马的情人。

text_en: Thus you longed for the lewdness of your youth, when the Egyptians fondled your bosom and caressed your young breasts.
text_cn: 于是你渴望你年轻时的淫行，那时埃及人曾抚摸过你的胸怀，抚弄过你青春的乳房。

text_en: Therefore, O Oholibah, thus says the Lord God : I will rouse against you your lovers from whom you turned in disgust, and I will bring them against you from every side:
text_cn: 因此，敖曷里巴！吾主上主这样说：看，我要鼓动你所厌弃的情人来攻击你，引他们从四周来攻击你，

text_en: the Babylonians and all the Chaldeans, Pekod and Shoa and Koa, and all the Assyrians with them, handsome young men, governors and commanders all of them, officers and warriors, all of them riding on horses.
text_cn: 即巴比伦人和一切加色丁人，培科得、芍亚和科亚， 以及一切同他们联合的亚述人，英俊的青年，一切长官和公卿、军官和将领，一切善于骑马的人。

text_en: They shall come against you from the north with chariots and wagons and a host of peoples; they shall set themselves against you on every side with buckler, shield, and helmet, and I will commit the judgment to them, and they shall judge you according to their ordinances.
text_cn: 他们率领大军、车辆和辎重车，大队士卒，都佩着甲、盾和盔，由四周攻击你。我让他们处罚你，照他们的法律判决你。

text_en: I will direct my indignation against you, in order that they may deal with you in fury. They shall cut off your nose and your ears, and your survivors shall fall by the sword. They shall seize your sons and your daughters, and your survivors shall be devoured by fire.
text_cn: 如此，我要在你身上发泄我的妒火，让他们以愤怒待你，割去你的鼻子和耳朵； 其余的都死于刀下；他们还要掳去你的子女，余下的都为火烧死。

text_en: They shall also strip you of your clothes and take away your fine jewels.
text_cn: 他们还要剥光你的衣服，夺去你的装饰品。

text_en: So I will put an end to your lewdness and your whoring brought from the land of Egypt; you shall not long for them, or remember Egypt any more.
text_cn: 这样，我才消除你心中的淫荡，和由埃及地开始的淫行，使你再不敢举目看他们，再不想念埃及。

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : I will deliver you into the hands of those whom you hate, into the hands of those from whom you turned in disgust;
text_cn: 因为吾主上主这样说：看，我要将你交在你所恼恨的人手中，和你所厌恶的人手中。

text_en: and they shall deal with you in hatred, and take away all the fruit of your labor, and leave you naked and bare, and the nakedness of your whorings shall be exposed. Your lewdness and your whorings
text_cn: 他们要以恼恨对待你，夺去你的一切财物，赤身露体的抛弃你：因此你放荡的私处，好色和淫乱都要暴露出来。

text_en: have brought this upon you, because you played the whore with the nations, and polluted yourself with their idols.
text_cn: 他们这样对待你，是因为你同异民行了淫，受了他们偶像的玷污。

text_en: You have gone the way of your sister; therefore I will give her cup into your hand.
text_cn: 你既然走了你姐姐的路，我也要把她的苦爵放在你手中。

text_en: Thus says the Lord God : You shall drink your sister’s cup, deep and wide; you shall be scorned and derided, it holds so much.
text_cn: 吾主上主这样说：你要喝你姐姐又深又大，容量又多的苦爵，你要成为耻笑和辱骂的对象，

text_en: You shall be filled with drunkenness and sorrow. A cup of horror and desolation is the cup of your sister Samaria;
text_cn: 你要酩酊大醉，满怀忧愁。你姐姐撒玛黎雅的爵是惊惶和毁灭的爵，

text_en: you shall drink it and drain it out, and gnaw its sherds, and tear out your breasts; for I have spoken, says the Lord God .
text_cn: 你必要喝，且要喝尽，连渣滓也要吞下；你还要抓破你自己的乳房：这是我所说的 —— 吾主上主的断语 ——

text_en: Therefore thus says the Lord God : Because you have forgotten me and cast me behind your back, therefore bear the consequences of your lewdness and whorings.
text_cn: 为此吾主上主这样说：因为你忘了我，把我抛在背后，你也要亲自承担你好色和淫乱的惩罚。”

text_en: The Lord said to me: Mortal, will you judge Oholah and Oholibah? Then declare to them their abominable deeds.
text_cn: 上主对我说：“人子，你要审判敖曷拉和敖曷里巴，向她们说明她们的丑恶：

text_en: For they have committed adultery, and blood is on their hands; with their idols they have committed adultery; and they have even offered up to them for food the children whom they had borne to me.
text_cn: 她们犯了奸淫，手上带着杀人的血，同偶像犯了奸淫，还焚化了她们给我所生的子女，祭祀偶像。

text_en: Moreover this they have done to me: they have defiled my sanctuary on the same day and profaned my sabbaths.
text_cn: 此外，她们还对我行了这事：在那一天她们还玷污了我的圣所，亵渎了我的安息日，

text_en: For when they had slaughtered their children for their idols, on the same day they came into my sanctuary to profane it. This is what they did in my house.
text_cn: 因为当她们给她们的偶像祭杀自己的子女时，同一天也进了我的圣所，加以亵渎。的确，她们在我圣殿中这样行了。

text_en: They even sent for men to come from far away, to whom a messenger was sent, and they came. For them you bathed yourself, painted your eyes, and decked yourself with ornaments;
text_cn: 并且他们还想从远方召人来，便遣使者到他们那里。看，他们果然来了，你就为了他们而沐浴，画眼，佩戴珠宝。

text_en: you sat on a stately couch, with a table spread before it on which you had placed my incense and my oil.
text_cn: 以后你坐在华丽的床上，床前安放桌子，上面摆上本来献给我的香和油。

text_en: The sound of a raucous multitude was around her, with many of the rabble brought in drunken from the wilderness; and they put bracelets on the arms of the women, and beautiful crowns upon their heads.
text_cn: 在她那里可以听到从旷野来的群众的欢乐嘈杂声，他们在她们姐妹的腕上带上镯子，在她们头上戴上花冠。

text_en: Then I said, Ah, she is worn out with adulteries, but they carry on their sexual acts with her.
text_cn: 那时我就关于这老淫妇说：现今她当然又要去行淫。

text_en: For they have gone in to her, as one goes in to a whore. Thus they went in to Oholah and to Oholibah, wanton women.
text_cn: 的确，人都到她们那里，就如到娼妓那里，也照样到淫妇敖曷拉和敖曷里巴那里。

text_en: But righteous judges shall declare them guilty of adultery and of bloodshed; because they are adulteresses and blood is on their hands.
text_cn: 但正义的人必要裁判她们，如裁判奸妇和流血的人，因为她们是奸妇，血还在她们手上。

text_en: For thus says the Lord God : Bring up an assembly against them, and make them an object of terror and of plunder.
text_cn: 因为吾主上主这样说：我要使许多人来攻击她们，叫她们饱受虐待并遭受抢掠。

text_en: The assembly shall stone them and with their swords they shall cut them down; they shall kill their sons and their daughters, and burn up their houses.
text_cn: 这群人要用石头砸死她们，用刀砍碎她们，屠杀她们的子女，火烧她们的房屋。

text_en: Thus will I put an end to lewdness in the land, so that all women may take warning and not commit lewdness as you have done.
text_cn: 如此，我要把淫乱由此地铲除，使所有的妇女受到警戒，不敢效法你们的淫行。

text_en: They shall repay you for your lewdness, and you shall bear the penalty for your sinful idolatry; and you shall know that I am the Lord God .
text_cn: 我要使你们的淫行归在你们身上。承担敬拜偶像的罪罚：如此，你们才承认我是上主。”
